form.label: Threat Hunting & Detection
form.description: Deep dive into suspicious activity - Active threat hunting and investigation

search.query: index=linux sourcetype=suricata:fast | rex "\[\*\*\]\s+\[(?<sid>[^\]]+)\]\s+(?<signature>[^\[]+)\[\*\*\]" | rex "\[Classification:\s+(?<classification>[^\]]+)\]" | rex "\[Priority:\s+(?<priority_num>\d+)\]" | rex "(?<src_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+):\d+\s+->\s+(?<dest_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+):(?<dest_port>\d+)" | stats count by signature, priority_num, src_ip, dest_ip, dest_port, classification | sort priority_num, -count | rename signature as "Signature", priority_num as "Priority", src_ip as "Source IP", dest_ip as "Dest IP", dest_port as "Dest Port", classification as "Category", count as "Events" | head 50

index=network sourcetype=zeek:notice notice_type IN ("C2_Beacon_Detected", "Malware_Callback", "Suspicious_TLS_Client", "Suspicious_Certificate") | eval threat_family=notice_msg | stats count as beacon_count, earliest(_time) as first_seen, latest(_time) as last_seen by src_ip, dest_ip, threat_family | eval duration=tostring(last_seen-first_seen, "duration") | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort -beacon_count | rename src_ip as "Infected Host", dest_ip as "C2 Server", threat_family as "C2 Family", beacon_count as "Beacons", first_seen as "First Seen", last_seen as "Last Seen", duration as "Duration"

index=network sourcetype=zeek:notice notice_type IN ("DCSync_Attack", "PSExec_Execution", "WMIExec_Execution", "DCOMExec_Execution", "ATExec_Execution", "Secretsdump_Registry", "Kerberoasting_Detected", "ASREP_Roasting_Detected", "SharpHound_Enumeration", "PetitPotam_Attack", "PrintNightmare_Attack", "Admin_Share_Access") | eval attack_category=case( notice_type IN ("DCSync_Attack", "Secretsdump_Registry"), "Credential Dumping", notice_type IN ("PSExec_Execution", "WMIExec_Execution", "DCOMExec_Execution", "ATExec_Execution"), "Lateral Movement", notice_type IN ("Kerberoasting_Detected", "ASREP_Roasting_Detected"), "Credential Access", notice_type IN ("SharpHound_Enumeration"), "Reconnaissance", notice_type IN ("PetitPotam_Attack", "PrintNightmare_Attack"), "Exploitation", notice_type IN ("Admin_Share_Access"), "Lateral Movement Prep", 1=1, "Other" ) | stats count as attack_count, values(dest_ip) as targets by src_ip, notice_type, attack_category | sort -attack_count | rename src_ip as "Attacker IP", notice_type as "Attack Type", attack_category as "MITRE Category", attack_count as "Events", targets as "Target Hosts"

index=network sourcetype=zeek:notice notice_type IN ("Admin_Share_Access", "PSExec_Execution", "WMIExec_Execution", "DCOMExec_Execution") | stats dc(dest_ip) as unique_targets, values(dest_ip) as target_list, count as attempts by src_ip | where unique_targets > 2 | sort -unique_targets | rename src_ip as "Source IP", unique_targets as "Unique Targets", attempts as "Total Attempts", target_list as "Target IPs"
index=network sourcetype=zeek:notice notice_type="Kerberoasting_Detected" | timechart span=5m count by src_ip limit=10

(index=network sourcetype=zeek:dns) OR (index=network sourcetype=technitium:syslog) OR (index=linux sourcetype=technitium:querylog) | eval query_length=len(query) | stats count as query_count, dc(query) as unique_queries, avg(query_length) as avg_length by src_ip | where query_count > 100 OR avg_length > 50 OR unique_queries > 50 | eval avg_length=round(avg_length, 1) | sort -query_count | rename src_ip as "Source IP", query_count as "Total Queries", unique_queries as "Unique Domains", avg_length as "Avg Query Length" | head 30

index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Sysmon" EventCode=1 | search (ParentImage="*\\winword.exe" OR ParentImage="*\\excel.exe" OR ParentImage="*\\powerpnt.exe") OR (Image="*\\powershell.exe" AND (CommandLine="*-enc*" OR CommandLine="*-w hidden*" OR CommandLine="*DownloadString*")) OR Image="*\\wmic.exe" OR Image="*\\psexec.exe" OR (Image="*\\net.exe" AND CommandLine="*user*") | table _time, ComputerName, ParentImage, Image, CommandLine, User | sort -_time | head 50
